query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

SCAIL model + WanVideoContextOptions crashes at nodes_sampler.py:2068 (partial_img_emb.clone()) because SCAIL doesn't pass standard image_embeds, leaving partial_img_emb None in the context-splitting path.

desired.outcome: OP's own root-cause analysis: SCAIL models don't produce standard image_embeds, so partial_img_emb is None when context splitting runs; fix would be guarding/deriving embeds in nodes_sampler.py (~line 2068). Suggested fix not merged and never confirmed by maintainer.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: OP's own root-cause analysis: SCAIL models don't produce standard image_embeds, so partial_img_emb is None when context splitting runs; fix would be guarding/deriving embeds in nodes_sampler.py (~line 2068). Suggested fix not merged and never confirmed by maintainer.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Root-cause the SCAIL crash at nodes_sampler.py:2068: SCAIL models produce no standard image_embeds, so partial_img_emb is None in the context-split path; propose a guard/derivation there.
